requirements.handling: Keep this skill inside the complete repository/plugin, including root scripts, cases and third_party. A folder-only skill export provides conversion helpers but not the repository-owned Origin pipeline.
Run the repository scripts/bootstrap.ps1 with Python 3.13.9 on Windows x64; requirements-win64.lock.txt pins the validated native environment. Conversion-only uses requirements.txt.
Provide licensed, activated Origin/OriginPro. Native validation is measured on OriginPro 2026 10.30018; doctor never connects to it.
The complete repository includes third_party/origin-mcp at ddab4420ccc7d17c056285b3b75191b1b81e48e5 with upstream MIT/NOTICE and a byte-level provenance manifest.
Supply an MPMS3 measurement DAT and explicitly confirmed sample mass in mg, or raw emu. Named cases use their catalog settings.
The adapter generates a private per-run loopback endpoint and authenticated handshake; no shared session or token is used.
Origin 2018-2025, non-Windows native plotting, independent machines and clean operating systems have not been hardware validated.
